purpose: Governed classifications for potentially-sensitive fields in the estate. Every entry cites its owner ruling. The response-sanitizer reads DIGICOW_PII_BANNED_FIELDS from services/response_sanitizer/__init__.py; entries here are the authoritative provenance for those inclusions and carry the declassification-path metadata a compliance reviewer needs.

classifications.rationale: Boolean/tinyint occupation-class field. On its own it is not directly identifying, but as a quasi-identifier it combines with adjacent columns (location, cluster, phone-band, adult marker) into a linkage risk. Under a conservative-default policy for quasi-identifiers this is PII until a documented linkage-risk assessment proves otherwise.

declassification_path.note: The path exists — declassification is legally and technically possible — but is CLOSED until BOTH a documented linkage-risk assessment AND DPO sign-off are on record. Owner Ruling #2 verbatim: 'the declassification path exists but is CLOSED until a documented linkage-risk assessment plus DPO sign-off says otherwise.'

classifications.ruling_ref: STATE/DECISIONS.md · Wave-G5c · 2026-08-28T~15:40Z · Owner Ruling #2 · verbatim: 'DigiCow occupation-boolean: PII. Masked at every crossing, never renders on a surface. Ruled under conservative-default policy for quasi-identifiers.'
